description: Retired flags, the mark refusal and the must-nots.
title: Finalise is the only writer of complete, never reads a verify report and never writes verified

acceptanceCriteria.description: [failure] When rcf build finalise FBS-001 --ci-run run-7 runs with each flag of [--report <path>, --max-report-age 7, --mode deterministic, --url http://localhost:8787, --allow-pre-merge] in turn, then it exits 2 with stderr "finalise no longer reads a verify report; Finalise writes complete from the recorded REVIEW, TEST and test-strength verdicts (rcf guidance build-cycle)", spawns nothing and writes nothing.

[must-not] Given the happy fixture plus a committed VerifyReport under rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/ whose verdict is FAIL (or one that is malformed), when Finalise runs, then it exits 0 with the same output as without the report: Finalise never opens a file under rcf/verify-reports/, and a passing report never stands in for a missing TEST verdict (the TEST-less fixture with a PASS report still exits 4 "no TEST verdict").

[failure] Given a fixture FBS-001 at inProgress, when rcf build mark FBS-001 complete runs, then it exits 4 with stderr "mark refused: complete is written only by rcf build finalise from the recorded verdicts" and rcf/fbs/fbs-001.json is byte-identical; rcf build mark FBS-001 inProgress and notStarted still work.

[edge] Given an amend round on FBS-001 at verified whose ReviewVerdict touches only testOnly criteria, Finalise exits 0 with stdout "finalise: FBS-001 verified (unchanged: touched criteria are testOnly)" and no write; when any touched criterion is external, it writes complete and stdout is the complete line.

[must-not] rcf build finalise never writes executionStatus verified in any mode or flag combination: across every fixture of this requirement, rcf/fbs/<fbs-id>.json never gains verified from a Finalise run.
